name: @local/dsh-tool-result-policy
description: Preset-scoped, live-toggleable tool-result retention: strip results no turn needs to remember, and truncate the rest.

meta.title: Tool-Result Retention
meta.description: Replaces the shipped tool-result pruner with one that also strips transient reads, spent entropy and mutation echoes. Measured: 72% of provider-bound bytes were retained tool output across 88 sessions.
